有间歇性强迫症的学渣沈哲，穿越到一个学霸的世界。
脑中多出一本可以改变规则，制定真理的造化图。
沈哲：消除同类项，我们的同时没了。
沈哲：军队是制式兵器，提取公因式，所以，就剩下一柄，在我手上。
某高手：我有秘法，可以一瞬间爆发两倍的力量。
沈哲想了想，将额头上的“2”擦掉，改成了“3”。
某异族大佬：只要传承不灭，我们早晚能杀光你们人族。
沈哲迟疑了一下，写下了三个字：“404”。
一瞬间，亿万书籍消失，异族文明毁灭。
你要乘坐飞行神兽，不好意思，我坐标平移就行了……
什么？嫌我丑？我是不敢加绝对值，加上之后，怕你扛不篆…

Shen Zhe, a low-achieving student with intermittent obsessive-compulsive disorder, traveled to a world of top academics.
There is an extra map of creation in your mind that can change the rules and formulate the truth.
Shen Zhe: Eliminate similar items, and we will be gone at the same time.
Shen Zhe: The army is a standard weapon, and the common factor is extracted, so there is only one weapon left in my hand.
A certain master: I have a secret method that can explode twice as much power in an instant.
Shen Zhe thought for a while, erased the "2" on his forehead and changed it to a "3".
A certain alien boss: As long as the inheritance remains, sooner or later we will be able to kill all of you humans.
Shen Zhe hesitated and wrote three words: "404".
In an instant, billions of books disappeared and alien civilization was destroyed.
